name: Takagi Shinji
source:
Atsuko and Yui's father. He's responsible for moving them to a new town.

[spoiler]What his daughters don't realize is he has already sold them as sex slaves for the town. He hopes that as slaves he'll be able to have sex with them himself . . .[/spoiler]
